description: Open loop lifecycle — user opens a concrete future-dated topic (job interview Thursday), talks about other things, then resolves it. Aria should track and pursue the loop, then let it close.

turns.message: Hey Aria. Big news: I landed an interview for the design lead job. It's this Thursday.
I'm excited but also kind of freaking out about it.
Anyway, enough about that. I tried that ramen place you'd have loved.
The broth was incredible. I sat there for two hours just people-watching.
My roommate adopted a cat, by the way. Tiny orange menace named Zuko.
He already knocked two plants off the windowsill. No remorse.
What did you get up to today, in that head of yours?
Okay, confession: I still haven't prepared my portfolio walkthrough.
Every time I sit down to practice, I find something else to do instead.
You're right. Okay. I'll block out tomorrow evening and run through it twice.
Did my practice run tonight. It actually went pretty well once I started.
Okay, it's Thursday. Heading in now. Wish me luck.
I'M BACK. It went SO well. They said I'll hear by Monday but the vibe was great.
The portfolio walkthrough you made me practice? Nailed it. They spent ten extra minutes on it.
Whatever happens Monday, I'm proud of how I showed up. Thanks for tracking this whole thing with me.
